summary: Iteration 5 — Verified Region-Aware Prices (INR/USD), localised Hire Me pills, and Cover Letter Tone selector (warm/formal/bold). All 23 backend pytests pass. All frontend flows work end-to-end with no console/page errors.

design_issues.screen: Cover letter modal (opened from Contact section)
issues: Modal is not centered to viewport — appears offset toward the left half of screen and the Contact section 'LOCATION' text (49, Baidyanath Dutta Sarani, Howrah — 113) visually overlaps the Tone pill row. Root cause: an ancestor of CoverLetterButton inside the Contact section has a CSS transform (likely from GSAP), which invalidates the `position: fixed; inset: 0` on the dialog backdrop and re-anchors it to the transformed ancestor. This is why iteration-note warned that force:true is needed to click tone pills. Recommend rendering the modal via a React portal to document.body (createPortal) so it escapes the transformed ancestor. Not blocking — functionality works; tone can be selected and PDF downloads correctly.

backend_pdf_verification.warm: GET /api/cover-letter?role=Product+Designer&tone=warm → 200 application/pdf. Extracted PDF text contains 'Dear Hiring Manager,' and 'Warm regards,'.
backend_pdf_verification.formal: GET /api/cover-letter?role=Product+Designer&company=Linear&tone=formal → 200 pdf. Contains 'Dear Linear Hiring Team,' and 'Sincerely,'.
backend_pdf_verification.bold: GET /api/cover-letter?role=Product+Designer&company=Linear&tone=bold → 200 pdf. Contains 'Hi Linear team,' and 'Talk soon,'.
backend_pdf_verification.invalid_tone_fallback: tone=invalidjunk → 200 pdf. Falls back to warm ('Dear Hiring Manager,' + 'Warm regards,').

frontend_verification.persistence: localStorage.ap_currency = INR after switch; INR remains selected across page reload.

action_items: (Design polish, non-blocking) Render the CoverLetterButton dialog via ReactDOM.createPortal(..., document.body) so `position: fixed; inset: 0` isn't constrained by a transformed ancestor in the Contact section. This will center the modal and stop the location text from bleeding through.
critical_code_review_comments: useCurrency.js: initial state is 'INR' before the useEffect swaps to detected/localStorage value → causes a brief flash where cards render INR then flip to USD on first paint. Consider lazy initializer that reads localStorage synchronously on mount to avoid the flash: `useState(() => readInitialCurrency())` — safe as long as it's guarded for SSR.

HireMeWidget budget-pill data-testids strip non-alphanumerics, so `< ₹1L` and `< $1.2k` both collapse to nearly identical ids (`hire-input-budget-1L` vs `hire-input-budget-12k`). Currently unique per currency, but if a new pill introduces a numeric collision it will silently reuse a testid. Consider a stable index-based key like `hire-input-budget-0..3`.
cover_letter.py L234 uses datetime.utcnow() which is deprecated in Python 3.12+; prefer datetime.now(timezone.utc).
Cover letter modal shares the same design/positioning issue flagged in design_issues — should be portalled.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed hire lead inserted via /api/hire (kept, not cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Currency toggle default follows navigator.language (en-US → USD). To exercise the INR default path in Playwright, either set page.emulate() with a hi-IN locale or pre-seed localStorage before the widget mounts. Cover letter modal positioning is offset due to transformed ancestor — use JS .click() or force=true on tone pills.
